name: airdnascraper
what_it_holds: Scrapy-based scraper (airdna.py, scrapy.cfg) with a committed output file airdna.csv: title, room_type, property_type, bedrooms, accommodates, bathrooms, reviews, rating, days_available, occ, revenue for a small set of listings in the NJ lake region (Hopatcong/Cranberry Lake/Sparta/Newton area). occ and revenue columns are blank/'permission_denied' in the sample rows shown, so the financially useful fields are not actually populated.
why_useful: A scraper of AirDNA's public market pages (rather than a paid-API client) would be the most direct route to realised ADR/occupancy proxies (gap #2) if AirDNA's site still exposes free market-level stats; scraping AirDNA (a non-Airbnb site) is explicitly in scope per our rules as a catalogued, unrun method.
themes: AirDNA / Mashvisor / AllTheRooms / Transparent / Key Data / Rabbu / Awning sample exports or scraped market pages committed to GitHub

name: UPGo-McGill/canada-analysis
what_it_holds: MIT-licensed R analysis code for Combs et al. 2019 ('Short-term cities: Airbnb's impact on Canadian housing markets'), the group's peer-reviewed study built on a 143-million-datapoint proprietary AirDNA-derived panel of daily Airbnb activity across Canadian cities (Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver and others) roughly 2016-2019. Repo structure shows an R/ directory, LICENSE, README; underlying raw AirDNA data itself is NOT committed (proprietary), only the analysis code.
why_useful: Full, citable, peer-reviewed replication code for a large-scale AirDNA-based STR study; documents exactly how commercial-operator share and revenue concentration were computed from AirDNA data, which is directly on-point for gap #2, even though the raw data underneath is not open.
time_coverage: ~2016-2019 (per published UPGo reports referencing this code)
size_hint: R analysis scripts, MIT license, 20 commits

name: AirROI Data Portal
what_it_holds: Non-GitHub commercial data portal claiming 20M+ listings across 190+ countries and 100,000+ markets, daily-refreshed, with free occupancy rates, revenue estimates, pricing trends, and downloadable CSV/JSON/Parquet exports; also referenced as having a GitHub-hosted Claude-Code tool that generates instant STR income reports from an Airbnb listing URL. No confirmation of a committed open dataset on GitHub -- the free tier appears to be a hosted web tool, not a repo.
why_useful: If AirROI's 'free' occupancy/revenue-estimate tier is genuinely queryable without payment, it would be a broader (and more current) analogue to AirDNA for gap #2 (190+ countries vs AirDNA's already-covered patch); flagging for a human to check the actual free-tier terms and whether a GitHub client exists, since scraping it is out of scope for this pass.

name: ericnost/NOLA-STR
what_it_holds: New Orleans official short-term-rental license data (Temporary, Accessory, and Commercial permit categories) current as of March 2018, joined to 2016 ACS 5-year block-group demographics (race/ethnicity, rent, income); includes an R script for parsing/joining. why_useful: Addresses gap #12 (city STR registration datasets) directly for New Orleans, one of our named target cities, and is a point-in-time (March 2018) municipal licence snapshot rather than an Airbnb-scraped listing count.
